fixed.explanation: IndexCol.validate_metadata calls array_equivalent with dtype_equal=True. That promises the dtypes match, but int and float categories differ in dtype. The low-level comparison then gets mismatched buffers and raises a buffer dtype error. I removed dtype_equal=True so mismatched dtypes are handled and the different-categories ValueError is raised.
